commitResults.messageTitle: Harden task storage and file handling
commitResults.messageBody: Validate malformed task data and escape save-file delimiters so storage errors do not crash Minty. Use an OS-independent relative path, handle missing files and directories, and expand UI coverage for storage edge cases.

Store task dates as LocalDate
commitResults.messageBody: Parse deadline and event dates in yyyy-MM-dd format and display them as MMM dd yyyy. Validate impossible dates and reversed event ranges.

commitResults.messageTitle: Find tasks occuring on a date
commitResults.messageBody: Add an on command that lists deadlines due on a requested date and events within inclusive date ranges. Exclude undated todos and validate missing or invalid query dates.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-8: add date-aware task management
Extract command-line interactions into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Move console input, formatting, greetings, task displays, and error output out of Minty so the main class can focus on coordinating commands. Preserve the existing user-visible behavior while establishing the first A-MoreOOP component boundary.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract command parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize command recognition, task index validation, date parsing, and task construction in a stateless Parser class. Reduce Minty to command coordination while preserving all existing validation messages and user-visible behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Encapsulate task operations in TaskList
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce TaskList as the owner of the mutable task collection and centralize add, delete, mark, unmark, count, iteration, and date-filtering operations. Update Minty and Storage to work through this abstraction so command coordination no longer depends on ArrayList internals.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor Minty into an application object
commitResults.messageBody: Store Ui, Storage, and TaskList as Minty instance fields, load persisted tasks during construction, and move the interaction lifecycle into run(). Keep main as a small OS-independent entry point so orchestration dependencies and responsibilities are explicit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce command lifecycle abstraction
commitResults.messageBody: Add an abstract Command execution contract with a default non-exit state, implement ExitCommand as the first concrete command, and let Minty's loop terminate through command polymorphism. Establish the foundation for moving remaining switch cases into command classes without changing console behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Route application flow through command objects
commitResults.messageBody: Teach Parser to create executable commands, extract list and date-query behavior into ListCommand and OnCommand, and reduce Minty's loop to parse, execute, and inspect exit state. Add a documented LegacyCommand bridge for mutation cases so they can be extracted incrementally without changing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task creation command hierarchy
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce AddCommand to centralize the add, persist, and confirmation workflow, with TodoCommand, DeadlineCommand, and EventCommand providing task-specific parsing. Update Parser to construct these commands and remove creation responsibilities from the transitional LegacyCommand.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete command class hierarchy
commitResults.messageBody: Extract mark, unmark, and delete behavior behind a shared IndexedTaskCommand workflow, add UnknownCommand for unsupported input, and update Parser to construct every concrete command. Remove the transitional LegacyCommand now that all command behavior is independently encapsulated.
